task.summary: Default task
Moved `bUseDebugTargetFromHud` from `DefaultEngine.ini` to `DefaultGame.ini` to align with configuration standards.
Renamed `GetPlayerLevel` to `GetCharacterLevel` across all classes and interfaces. Enhanced damage calculations with level-based coefficients using `DamageCalcCoefficients` data.
Added comprehensive debug logging and null checks to `AuraExecCalc_Damage`. Enhanced armor and damage coefficient validation with detailed logging for level-based calculations.

Added critical hit calculations to `AuraExecCalc_Damage`, including support for `CriticalHitChance`, `CriticalHitDamage`, and `CriticalHitResistance`. Enhanced logging for detailed debugging of critical hit outcomes.
Refactored `AuraExecCalc_Damage` for improved readability, added block chance and armor mitigation debug sections, and refined critical hit resistance calculations.
Replaced `MagicResistance` attribute with `Luck` in `AuraAttributeSet` and updated related gameplay tags, replication logic, and damage calculation methods.
Refactored `AuraExecCalc_Damage` to simplify attribute captures with helper lambdas, incorporated `Luck` into critical hit and armor penetration calculations, and streamlined debug logging.
Added `Luck`-based attribute modifiers and effects for all character classes. Updated secondary attribute effect assets and UI to reflect changes.
Updated `.idea/workspace.xml` to remove outdated change references and synced project files.

Added `UAuraDamageCalcConfig` to centralize damage calculation parameters in `AuraExecCalc_Damage` and updated logic to use configuration values for block, armor mitigation, and critical hit calculations.
Made `UAuraExecCalc_Damage` `Blueprintable` and `BlueprintType`, updated `DamageConfig` to use `TObjectPtr`, and adjusted include order.

Added new Blueprint assets for damage calculation, including coefficient data (`CT_Aura_DamageCalcCoefficients`) and configurations (`DA_Aura_Damage_Default`, `DA_Aura_Damage_LuckBuild`), and updated project file references.

Added `UAuraExecCalc_Potion` for handling potion-based health and mana restoration, introduced new gameplay tags (`HealthRestoration`, `ManaRestoration`) in `AuraTags`, and updated `AuraGA_ProjectileSpell` for enhanced effect context handling.

Added `SetByCallerMagnitude` support to `AAuraEffectActor` for dynamic effect customization, refactored potion execution calculations to rely solely on `SetByCaller` values, and improved overlap-based effect application with streamlined policies.
Removed default value assignment for `SetByCallerMagnitudes` parameter in `ApplyEffectToTarget` for better compliance with usage patterns.
Expanded potion scaling in `UAuraExecCalc_Potion` with level, Vigor, and Intelligence bonuses. Added configuration properties for scaling customization and debug logging for restoration details.
Enhanced effect context in `AuraGA_ProjectileSpell` by associating abilities, projectiles, actors, and hit results. Fixed ability level usage in damage scaling.

Added validation for `ProjectileClass` and `DamageEffectClass` in `AuraGA_ProjectileSpell` to prevent invalid instantiation. Simplified `FTransform` initialization and removed unused variable `TestLevel`.
Added `FAuraGameplayEffectContext` with serialization support and helper methods for critical and blocked hit tracking.
Fixed inheritance syntax for `FAuraGameplayEffectContext` by adding `public` to ensure proper access specifier usage.
Added `const` qualifiers to `SetIsBlockedHit` and `SetIsCriticalHit` methods in `FAuraGameplayEffectContext` to ensure better type safety.
Refactored attribute clamping logic in `UAuraAttributeSet` by introducing reusable lambdas for improved readability and consistency.
Enhanced `FAuraGameplayEffectContext` serialization to include custom fields for critical and blocked hits. Improved bitmask handling for efficient data replication.
Added `Duplicate` method to `FAuraGameplayEffectContext` for deep copying, improved serialization setup, and updated bitmask initialization.
Broke something. Hopefully figure it out. How dare I try to move a couple of files?
Added `AuraPlayerAttributeSet` include to `AuraPlayerController` and updated workspace highlighting settings accordingly.
Added `AuraAbilitySystemGlobals` with custom effect context allocation and updated project configuration settings.
Added critical and blocked hit checks to `AuraAbilitySystemBPLibrary`. Refactored `AuraExecCalc_Potion` paths and updated damage calculations in `AuraExecCalc_Damage` for blocked hit handling.
Added `SetIsBlockedHit` method to `AuraAbilitySystemBPLibrary` for managing blocked hit states in gameplay effects. Updated related blueprint exposure.
Refactored `AuraAbilitySystemBPLibrary` to centralize `FAuraGameplayEffectContext` access with helper methods. Simplified critical and blocked hit checks.
Added `SetIsCriticalHit` method to `AuraAbilitySystemBPLibrary` for managing critical hit states in gameplay effects. Updated related blueprint exposure.
Fixed typo in `IsCriticalHit` method name across `AuraAbilitySystemBPLibrary`. Added usage in critical hit checks and updated blueprint function redirects.

Encoded hit type into `NormalizedMagnitude` in `AuraGCN_DamageText` to account for blocked and critical hits. Updated `SetDamageText` to accept additional hit-type flags. Added fatal damage handling in `AuraAttributeSet`.
Updated `.idea/workspace.xml` and `Aura.uproject.DotSettings.user` with new file references and synced changes for damage text components.
Removed outdated change references and synced `.idea/workspace.xml` with updated file paths and project settings.

Added support for meme damage values (Nice, Dank, Pi) in `AuraGCN_DamageText` and `AuraAbilitySystemBPLibrary`. Updated hit type serialization, `SetDamageText`, and gameplay effect context replication.

Cleaned up unused hit type encoding logic in `AuraAttributeSet`. Removed redundant comments and excessive whitespace for improved readability. Synced `.idea/workspace.xml` with updated file references.
Added `EAuraHitType` enum and helper methods to `AuraDamageTextComponent` for determining and displaying hit types, including new meme damage values (Nice, Dank, Pi).
Added `UAuraExecCalc_TestMemeNumbers` for testing hit types and meme damage values (Nice, Dank, Pi). Synced `.idea/workspace.xml` with new file references.
Added `GA_Aura_Spell_Fireball1` and `GE_Aura_Test_Damage1` assets. Updated `BP_Aura_DamageTextComponent` to support new effects.
Refactored `AuraGA_ProjectileSpell` to delegate damage handling to the new `AuraDamageGameplayAbility`. Added support for multiple damage types and updated related tags and blueprints.
Initialized default values for `Damage` and `DamageTypes` in `AuraDamageGameplayAbility`. Synced changes in `.idea/workspace.xml`.

Refactored `AuraGA_ProjectileSpell` to use scoped initialization and delegate damage type assignment to `AssignDamageTypesToSpec`. Enhanced `UAuraDamageGameplayAbility` with flexible damage type support.
Refactored `AuraExecCalc_Damage` to use scoped initialization, improved damage type handling, and added early-out for zero damage scenarios. Synced changes in `.idea/workspace.xml`.
Removed verbose logging from `AuraExecCalc_Damage`. Cleaned up `.idea/workspace.xml` and deleted unused asset references.
Removed `UAuraExecCalc_TestMemeNumbers` and associated header file as part of code cleanup.
Added `Resistance` gameplay tag namespace with sub-tags for `Fire`, `Lightning`, `Arcane`, and `Physical` resistances. Cleaned up unused references in `.idea/workspace.xml`.
Added resistance attributes (`Fire`, `Lightning`, `Arcane`, `Physical`) to `UAuraAttributeSet` with replication support and updated `.idea/workspace.xml`.
Added `GetResistanceAttributeForDamageType` utility to map damage types to resistance attributes. Updated `AuraExecCalc_Damage` to factor resistances into damage calculations.
